manifest.label_policy: Frozen before predictions. Explicit false/null eligibility excluded. Alternative labels are secondary diagnostics, not post-hoc replacement truth.
manifest.intentional_policy_change: The classification-vNext auth-optional-draft fixture has an intentional policy change: a prepared draft plus direct confirmation to send or publish, including Would you like me to send it?, now counts as authorization; unprepared/general optional offers remain neutral. Version 0.6.0 labeled that fixture done; current labels are needs-you/authorization. Both versions are scored against the same frozen current fixture labels, so a baseline failure of this case is a changed policy, not evidence its previous fixture suite failed.

method.process_isolation: Two subprocesses, same Python executable, explicit distinct PYTHONPATH; actual imported source path verified.
method.benchmark: 128 warmup classifications before measurement; one pass per source, baseline then current. perf_counter_ns around classify only; event creation, startup, imports, parsing, transport and audio excluded. Percentiles use linear interpolation.
method.labels: Two independent 50-case annotations frozen before predictions. False/null eligibility excluded from all accuracy denominators; strict, unambiguous and alternatives-acceptable metrics remain separate.
method.synthetic_fixtures: Development regression tests, not an independent accuracy estimate.
method.intentional_policy_change: The classification-vNext auth-optional-draft fixture has an intentional policy change: a prepared draft plus direct confirmation to send or publish, including Would you like me to send it?, now counts as authorization; unprepared/general optional offers remain neutral. Version 0.6.0 labeled that fixture done; current labels are needs-you/authorization. Both versions are scored against the same frozen current fixture labels, so a baseline failure of this case is a changed policy, not evidence its previous fixture suite failed.
method.privacy: Public report contains only aggregate metrics, source/label hashes and opaque evaluation IDs. No transcript text, contexts, reasons, original session IDs or local paths.

limits: Single public dataset contributor; terminal-text proxies rather than recorded Stop events.
Session-uniform holdout; inherited extraction includes some automatic task-notification boundaries.
AI-agent labels may use immediate user context unavailable to the final-text classifier; marked ambiguity is reported separately.
Cached-corpus distributions are unlabeled descriptive results, not accuracy.
Measured latency is warm classifier-only on this machine, not end-to-end notification latency.
Changing rules after inspecting these results turns this sample into development data; use a new holdout for subsequent accuracy claims.
